name: the capital and its hinterland
elevated_in: antique: the largest library on the continent, almost none of it originally theirs
scar: none (the center is unscarred, which it considers proof of favor)
texture: translations whose originals no longer exist; astronomers using tables computed a thousand miles east; physicians trained on a text the capital once condemned

name: the Drowned March
elevated_in: socially: assembly-based succession, women holding property and title, contract law where the center has patronage
scar: a rift valley that filled; a lake with a visible former shoreline
explanation_sacred: divine judgment on the old seat
texture: in dry years the top of a bell tower breaks the surface; villages sit on the new shoreline and farm the old one

name: the Ashland
elevated_in: medically: hospitals with wards, optical and surgical instruments up the trade road
scar: a volcanic field; spectacular soil, bad air
explanation_sacred: the earth was punished and the punishment feeds us
explanation_material: ordinary vulcanism on a long cycle
texture: miasma tiles live here and stop being generic fog; people farm it anyway because the crops are extraordinary; the Miasma Warden class was born in this ground

name: the Glass Flats
elevated_in: mathematically: algebra used for inheritance law, instruments, double-entry along the road
scar: fused ground, straight-edged, unmistakably made; nothing grows
explanation_sacred: a weapon, a thousand years old, per the state
explanation_material: a weapon, two hundred years old, per a manifest the Company's factors hold
texture: Namibian register: white sky, hard noon light, mineral color, a single figure legible at distance. Beautiful, not gothic

name: the Stepped Coast
elevated_in: administratively: decimal officialdom, a labor tax, storehouse networks, knotted-cord records no living person can read
scar: three raised marine terraces, each a former shoreline, each with a ruined harbor at the wrong altitude
explanation_sacred: the sea was driven back by an act of will
explanation_material: the land rises on a schedule nobody is on
texture: the quietest and most unsettling scar; purely tectonic and entirely undramatic

name: the Throat
elevated_in: commercially: credit instruments, brokerage, letters of exchange
scar: none; the road itself is the feature
texture: the Huma drifts here rather than nesting; it never lands, so it belongs to a road rather than a place

name: the Shoulder
elevated_in: spiritually: the only place on the map everyone agrees is different, and nobody agrees why
scar: the mountain wall itself -- no scar, because nothing happened to it; it is simply higher than anywhere people can live
explanation_sacred: the veil is thin and the dead are near
explanation_material: the air thins and the body fails; men see things because they are suffocating slowly
texture: Above the treeline nothing grows. ONE PHENOMENON, FIVE READINGS: the Continuing Word says the veil is thin; the court sect says thin air makes men foolish; the Company does not go, because there is nothing up there to trade with; the Unstained say it is the only ground clean enough to matter; the silent are already up there and will not discuss it. The Throat is the one gap through the wall, which is why the road is worth what it is worth.
